sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate your binding volume commitment of 94,800 kg over 24 months, which allows us to improve our offer.
Building on your second package with the AS-14404 index clause and 30-day payment terms, we propose €5.63 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Our terms: a price of €5.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

The volume forecast you provided was already factored into our previous offer and does not change our calculation.

And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. We appreciate your acceptance of the AS-14404 index clause, which provides stability for both sides. However, your proposed price increase is too small to bridge the gap to our cost realities. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stands at a price of €5.42 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days. We hope these terms allow us to continue serving your needs, and we look forward to hearing your decision soon.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

However, your proposed price increase is too small to bridge the gap to our cost realities.
